summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「模型幻觉、事实失真与长程一致性退化」痛点，作者围绕 **Sound and Complete Neuro-symbolic Reasoning** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、智能体运行脚手架（Agentic Harness）。核心论点主张：We present a method for directly integrating an LLM into the interpretation function of the formal semantics for a paraconsistent logic。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We present a method for directly integrating an LLM into the interpretation function of the formal semantics for a paraconsistent logic。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Unlike prior work, our method offers a theoretical framework for neuro-symbolic reasoning that leverages an LLM's knowledge while preserving the underlying logic's soundness and...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)、幻觉抑制、机器遗忘与水印 (Factuality & Unlearning)** 中的「模型幻觉、事实失真与长程一致性退化」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Hashed Watermark as a Filter: Defeating Forging and Overwriting Attacks in Weight-based Neural Network Watermarking
